name: Tom Fox
life: “I still remember keeping the shift log through a long blackout.” People around Maré Coffee know Tom by a small Wednesday habit. Tom likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I keep our shift diary and had never recorded anything that served no business purpose. I made room.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a black overshirt with pearl buttons and a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. Tom has two dimples that appear only with a full smile, with brown hair pinned away from the temples. Tom presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Tom finds it easier to own up to a mistake than to accept praise. The worse the mistake, the more precise the account of exactly when it happened.
agenda: To record the gull in the shift diary.
family: Rae Vargas is Tom’s cousin. Tom remembers the birthdays. Rae asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The uniform money*, Rae says, “I drew a timetable for sharing the iron. The children rearranged it by bus times.”
connections: Martin Rahman. The painter's first date goes into a shift log alongside the shadow.
